The design imagines a matatu as a presidential candidate, complete with campaign slogans and a commanding portrait \u2014 a wry commentary on Kenya's political landscape and the outsized personalities that dominate it. Dennis Muraguri's woodcut captures the gravity and absurdity in equal measure. This piece captures that tradition at its most playful, turning the campaign poster into a mobile art installation that commuters encountered on their daily routes.
